title: The Crown Beyond Crowns
text:
Vaelor Veyr appeared without an army.

The surviving Crowns lowered their heads as he passed.

Even Aurel.

That mattered more than any title.

The **Crown Beyond Crowns** looked almost ordinary at first glance.

No giant weapon.

No theatrical armor.

No visible pressure storm.

Then he stepped onto the western plateau Lei had prepared.

Every buried conductor hummed at once.

Rui's water channels trembled.

Liang's White Blood lattice registered six independent circulation signatures inside one body.

Jin's expression changed.

Six.

Exactly as the foreign archives described.

Vaelor looked across the battlefield at the Five Dukes.

[[speaker:vaelor]]“All of you?”

Kael stepped forward.

[[speaker:kael]]“Enough.”

The leader smiled.

The final war began.

title: A World With Six Suns
text:
Vaelor revealed **A WORLD WITH SIX SUNS** immediately.

Six circulation authorities.

Upper force.

Movement.

Recovery.

Defense.

Breath.

Central pressure.

Each could continue functioning if another was damaged.

Rui opened the battlefield with water.

Lei used the water as thunder pathways.

Liang attacked circulation through the conductive routes.

Jin controlled the handoffs.

Kael drove straight through the openings.

Five Dukes.

One coordinated organism.

Vaelor lost one Sun.

Then another.

Liang stopped recovery.

Lei destroyed breath pressure.

Rui isolated movement.

Jin forced defense into a bad transfer.

Kael struck central pressure.

Vaelor crossed three ridges.

Hit the ground.

Did not rise.

For several seconds, everyone believed the Five Dukes had won.

title: The True Crown
text:
Vaelor opened his eyes.

A seventh circulation authority awakened beneath the six known Suns.

The **True Crown**.

Not another support route.

The original authority governing the others.

The six Suns had been outer architecture.

The Five Dukes had spent enormous strength defeating the shell.

The True Crown restarted what remained.

Cleaner.

Stronger.

Lei's face went still.

Liang coughed blood.

Jin's model became obsolete.

Rui's reserves were already low.

Kael remained upright.

Vaelor stood.

[[speaker:vaelor]]“Again.”

The second battle was not equal.

It became survival.

title: Duke Four Is Broken
text:
Vaelor chose Lei because thunder annoyed him.

That was all.

He slammed World Rank #4 into the ground.

Once.

Twice.

Again.

Lei tried to discharge thunder through the contact.

Vaelor broke the wrist.

Then drove his heel into Lei's forearm until the bone gave way.

Sera shouted from the ridge.

Kael attacked.

Vaelor threw Lei into him.

The Duke of the Black Storm hit the stone again.

Still conscious.

Vaelor dragged him upright by the hair.

[[speaker:vaelor]]“Thunder.”

Lei spat blood in his face.

Vaelor smiled.

Then smashed Lei's head into the ground hard enough to crater the plateau.

Again.

Liang forced White Blood into Lei's brain circulation remotely to keep him alive.

Vaelor noticed.

He shifted the next stomp to Lei's torso and broke three ribs instead.

The torture stopped only when Rui flooded the entire plateau between them.

Lei was left close to death.

Unconscious.

One arm mangled.

Skull fractured.

Ribs broken.

If Liang had reacted one breath later, #4 would have died.

title: Liang and Jin Break
text:
Liang nearly stopped the True Crown.

That was her achievement.

White Blood entered the deepest circulation handoff and slowed it for less than one breath.

Jin used that breath perfectly.

Three tactical strikes landed.

Vaelor's chest opened.

The True Crown staggered.

For a moment, #2 and #3 nearly solved him.

Then Vaelor destroyed the terrain Jin had modeled.

The strategic map vanished beneath broken stone.

Jin adapted.

Too late.

One impact ruptured internal blood vessels.

Liang moved to stabilize him.

Vaelor attacked her instead.

She blocked.

Badly.

Both Dukes fell within seconds of each other.

Only Kael remained standing.

title: Kael Is Beaten Hard
text:
Kael faced Vaelor alone.

Official World #1.

Unmoving Heaven.

No excuses.

He fought brilliantly.

Vaelor still outclassed him.

Kael struck the sternum.

Vaelor's recovery authority absorbed the burden.

Kael changed centre.

Vaelor attacked the transition.

Kael broke one outer Sun.

Vaelor broke three ribs and one shoulder line.

Kael stayed upright.

Vaelor caught him by the back of the neck and drove him face-first into the plateau.

Kael pushed up.

Vaelor kicked him across the crater.

Kael returned.

World #1 forced Vaelor backward once.

That was his victory inside the loss.

Then Vaelor dismantled him.

Body.

Breath.

Centre.

Kael finally hit the ground and could not stand.

All Five Dukes had been defeated hard.

The leader looked almost disappointed.

title: All Five Dukes Fall
text:
Kael took one knee.

Stood.

Vaelor hit him again.

Kael remained upright.

Third strike.

Fourth.

Unmoving Heaven kept returning force to centre until there was no centre left strong enough to hold it.

Kael finally fell.

All Five Dukes defeated.

Together.

Not separately.

Not through tricks.

They had coordinated well enough to destroy Six Suns.

The True Crown still beat them.

Every Duke was gravely injured.

Rui unable to move.

Lei's arm destroyed.

Liang bleeding internally.

Jin barely conscious.

Kael unable to stand.

Vaelor looked at the five bodies.

[[speaker:vaelor]]“Your Dukes are worthy.”

Then walked toward Kael.

Boundless Horizon opened behind him.

title: The Horizon King Arrives
text:
Tae Muyeon stepped onto the battlefield.

Unofficial co-#1.

No smile.

No joke.

Vaelor turned.

[[speaker:vaelor]]“Another Duke?”

[[speaker:tae]]“No.”

Then the final metre disappeared.

Tae's fist landed before Vaelor completed the turn.

Boundless Horizon denied the True Crown clean engagement.

Near range became wrong.

Middle range became late.

Long range collapsed into nothing useful.

For several minutes, Vaelor could not touch him.

Tae hit ribs.

Jaw.

Sternum.

The Crown Beyond Crowns finally looked irritated.

Then the True Crown began assigning different authorities to different distances.

Tae's world became much smaller.

title: Tae Nearly Dies
text:
Vaelor caught Tae after twenty-seven minutes.

One bad measure.

That was all.

The Horizon King solved the first distance.

The second arrived through it.

His leg broke.

He stayed standing.

Vaelor hit him again.

Tae spat blood.

[[speaker:tae]]“Still unpleasant.”

Kael heard from the ground.

Almost smiled.

Tae tried **Heaven Is Always One Step Away** again.

Vaelor collapsed the final step.

Tae fell.

Vaelor reached for his throat.

Then Kael stood up again.

He should not have.

He did.

title: Two Number Ones
text:
Official #1 stood beside unofficial co-#1.

Both already badly injured.

Tae looked at Kael.

[[speaker:tae]]“Late.”

[[speaker:kael]]“Injured.”

[[speaker:tae]]“Excuse.”

Vaelor attacked.

Kael owned centre.

Tae owned distance.

Kael forced commitment.

Tae punished transition.

For a short, glorious stretch, the two Number Ones overpowered the True Crown.

One outer Sun collapsed.

Vaelor's shoulder broke.

Kael landed cleanly.

Tae landed twice.

Then Vaelor stopped preserving himself.

The True Crown synchronized every surviving authority at maximum burden.

All three moved at once.
